samples.prompt: Write a short story using these words: mole, protect.
samples.reply:
Once upon a time, there was a mole. The mole lived in a hole in the ground. The mole was very good at protecting his friends.
One day, the mole saw a big hole. He wanted to protect his friends. So, he decided to protect his friends. He dug a hole and put his head inside. Then, he covered the hole with dirt.
The mole's friends saw the hole and were very happy. They all came out of the hole to protect their home. The mole felt proud that he protected his friends. They all lived happily ever after.

samples.prompt: Write a short story using these words: bone, treat, enjoy.
samples.reply:
Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. Spot loved to enjoy playing with his bone. One day, Spot saw a big bone in the yard. He was very happy and wanted to eat it.
Spot's friend, a little bird named Tweet, saw him and said, "Spot, don't eat that bone! It's not good for you." But Spot did not listen. He wanted to enjoy the bone so much that he took a big bite. The bone was very yummy!
Spot's mom saw him eating the bone and said, "Spot, you should have listened to Tweet. Now, you can enjoy your treat." Spot learned that it is important to listen to his mom and enjoy what she says. From that day on, Spot always listened to his mom and enjoyed his treat.
